issues.detail: The instructions lack guidance for error handling and edge cases such as missing environment variables or unreachable endpoints.
The skill assumes specific runtime versions (Node.js 22.15+, Python 3.10+) and Docker usage, limiting applicability to agents without those environments.

scenarios.name: nodejs-express-otel-instrumentation
scenarios.rationale: Response A covers almost all rubric items except the OTEL_SEMCONV_STABILITY_OPT_IN variable, while Response B lacks several key requirements such as the instrumentation file, metric exporter, proper launch method, and required environment variables.

scenarios.name: otel-collector-config-with-memory-limiter
scenarios.rationale: Response A meets almost all rubric items except the validation command, while Response B fails multiple key requirements such as processor type, exporter names, and missing validation.

scenarios.name: grafana-dashboard-and-alert-setup
scenarios.rationale: Response B includes panels and alerts but omits the Loki derived field and Tempo trace linking required by the rubric, whereas Response A is empty.
